accepted.s: The tribal communities displaced by the Polavaram Project are reported to be predominantly which of the following?
accepted.x: The displaced population is predominantly composed of Koya and Kondh tribals.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise community names instead of relying on broad tribal associations.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a major complaint associated with the rehabilitation of Polavaram-affected tribal communities?
accepted.x: The reported complaints include land-rights violations, low compensation and poor rehabilitation. Excessive employment generation is not identified as a complaint.
accepted.tq: Find the option that does not belong to the stated set of grievances.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s: The submergence and displacement associated with the Polavaram Project are also reported to threaten which of the following?
accepted.x: The submergence is reported to endanger Koya river traditions along with the displacement of tribal communities.
accepted.tq: Test the cultural consequence separately from the administrative rehabilitation issues.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding land acquisition and rehabilitation for the Polavaram Project:
1. Land acquisition and rehabilitation were only 27.40% complete in December 2025 according to the CDI Survey analysis.
2. By August 2026, land acquisition had reached 94%.
3. By August 2026, relocation of project-affected families had reached 52%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The 27.40% figure represented the combined progress of land acquisition and R&R in December 2025, while separate August 2026 figures were 94% for land acquisition and 52% for family relocation.
accepted.tq: Split combined and component percentages before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s: What was the stated target for completion of the R&R colonies of the Polavaram Project?
accepted.x: The R&R colonies were targeted for completion by December 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the R&R-colony deadline from the overall project-completion deadline.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s:
With reference to compensation for the Polavaram Project, consider the following statements:
1. ₹1,943 crore was paid in three phases.
2. The value of a house site in R&R colonies was increased from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh.
3. Compensation follows the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Compensation of ₹1,943 crore was paid in three phases, house-site value was doubled to ₹2 lakh, and compensation follows the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.
accepted.tq: Combine a numerical fact, a revised entitlement and the governing legislation.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s: The value of a house site in the rehabilitation and resettlement colonies was increased from ₹1 lakh to:
accepted.x: The house-site value was doubled from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh.
accepted.tq: Use the before-and-after values to identify the revised compensation provision.
accepted.sec: R&R issues - tribal displacement, compensation, court cases

accepted.s: Cases concerning submergence in which two neighbouring States are pending before the Supreme Court?
accepted.x: Submergence-related cases involving Odisha and Chhattisgarh are pending before the Supreme Court.
accepted.tq: Match the legal dispute with the correct neighbouring States.

accepted.x: The December 2025 figures were 60.8% overall, 81.61% for head works, 92.79% for the right main canal and 73.40% for the left main canal.

Which of the following works were stated to have been completed in the Polavaram Project?
1. Spillway and radial gates
2. Coffer dams
3. Gap-III concrete dam and buttress dam
Select the correct answer using the code given below.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the diaphragm wall of the Polavaram Project:
1. Its length is 1,372 metres.
2. Reconstruction began on 18 January 2025.
3. Reconstruction was completed in 440 days.
4. The additional cost was approximately ₹1,000 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The 1,372-metre diaphragm wall was rebuilt from 18 January 2025, completed in 440 days and involved an additional cost of about ₹1,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Check every numerical and chronological detail before choosing the comprehensive option.
accepted.sec: Status - diaphragm wall, completion timelines, expert reviews

accepted.s: The reconstruction of the Polavaram diaphragm wall was announced as completed on:
accepted.x: Completion of the diaphragm wall reconstruction was announced on 2 April 2026. The additional-cost report appeared on 3 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the completion-announcement date from the subsequent cost-report date.
accepted.sec: Status - diaphragm wall, completion timelines, expert reviews

accepted.s: A foreign expert panel, during its sixth visit in association with the Central Water Commission, reviewed which of the following?
o: Only the spillway and radial gates
Gap-1, Gap-2 and the diaphragm wall
The R&R colonies and compensation records
Only the right and left main canals
accepted.x: The foreign expert panel, with the CWC, reviewed Gap-1, Gap-2 and the diaphragm wall during its sixth visit.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact scope of an expert review rather than the broader project components.
accepted.sec: Status - diaphragm wall, completion timelines, expert reviews

accepted.s: The Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal was set up in 1969 and gave its award in:
accepted.x: The Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal was set up in 1969 and its award was given in 1980.
accepted.tq: Arrange the tribunal’s constitution and award using the two linked dates.
accepted.sec: GWDT clauses - Polavaram and Godavari-to-Krishna diversion

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1980 Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal award:
1. It cleared Polavaram with an FRL of +150 feet.
2. It allowed diversion of 80 TMC of Godavari water into the Krishna above Vijayawada.
3. Of the 80 TMC, Andhra Pradesh was allocated 45 TMC.
4. Karnataka and Maharashtra together were allocated 35 TMC.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The award provided for Polavaram at FRL +150 feet and diversion of 80 TMC, distributed as 45 TMC to Andhra Pradesh and 35 TMC to Karnataka and Maharashtra together.
accepted.tq: Verify the total allocation and its State-wise distribution before selecting the full combination.
accepted.sec: GWDT clauses - Polavaram and Godavari-to-Krishna diversion

accepted.s: The 35 TMC allocated to Karnataka and Maharashtra under the Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal award was divided as:
o: 20 TMC to Karnataka and 15 TMC to Maharashtra
25 TMC to Karnataka and 10 TMC to Maharashtra
14 TMC to Karnataka and 21 TMC to Maharashtra
21 TMC to Karnataka and 14 TMC to Maharashtra
accepted.x: The 35 TMC was divided into 21 TMC for Karnataka and 14 TMC for Maharashtra.
accepted.tq: Break the combined allocation into its two State-wise components.
accepted.sec: GWDT clauses - Polavaram and Godavari-to-Krishna diversion

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of projects is associated with the Godavari-to-Krishna diversion arrangement linked to the Polavaram system?
accepted.x: The linked projects are Pattiseema and the proposed Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link, earlier called Banakacherla.

accepted.s: Pattiseema is best described as:

A permanent dam across the Krishna River near Vijayawada
A rehabilitation colony for displaced tribals
accepted.x: Pattiseema is a temporary lift arrangement into the Polavaram Right Main Canal.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a linked lift project from a dam, tribunal or R&R institution.

accepted.s: The proposed Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link was earlier known as:
accepted.x: The proposed Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar link was earlier known as the Banakacherla link.
accepted.tq: Test the earlier and present names of the same proposed link project.

accepted.s:
Telangana has contended that the Godavari-to-Krishna link violates which of the following?
1. The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014
2. The 1980 Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal award
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Telangana has argued that the link violates both the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 and the 1980 GWDT award.
accepted.tq: Pair the legal instrument with the river-dispute award rather than treating the objection as purely technical.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly states the current completion-related position associated with the Polavaram Project?
1. The target is March 2027.
2. The target is before the 2027 Godavari Pushkaralu.
3. The Union Budget 2026-27 provided ₹3,320 crore for storage up to 41.15 metres.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The completion target is March 2027, before the 2027 Godavari Pushkaralu, and ₹3,320 crore was provided for storage up to 41.15 metres in Budget 2026-27.
accepted.tq: Combine the revised timeline with the budgetary allocation and its storage limit.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements best expresses a major criticism concerning the storage level of the Polavaram Project?
o: The FRL was reduced from 41.15 metres to 35 metres.
Phase-I storage is planned at 45.72 metres instead of 41.15 metres.
The project has no provision for Phase-I storage.
Phase-I storage is planned at 41.15 metres instead of the 45.72-metre FRL.
accepted.x: A major criticism is that Phase-I storage is proposed at 41.15 metres, below the full reservoir level of 45.72 metres.
accepted.tq: Read the reversed comparison carefully: interim storage is lower than the full FRL.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following issues remains unresolved in relation to the Polavaram Project?
o: The revised cost estimate has not yet been cleared.
The Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal has not been constituted.
No rehabilitation policy exists for affected families.
The project has not been declared a national project.
accepted.x: The revised cost estimate had not yet been cleared. The other statements contradict the stated position or introduce facts not supported here.
accepted.tq: Identify the unresolved administrative issue without confusing it with settled project features.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
